name: Jira worktime tracking app
about: Building a time tracking app for Jira Cloud and releasing it on the Atlassian Marketplace, in three stages: time logging (issue panel, timer, weekly timesheet), reports and timesheet approvals, then the paid Marketplace release. The top of the tree is split into stages (milestones), and every stage has the same four phases: Analysis, Implementation, Tests and Deployment, so each stage ends with something released and signed off. Every task is estimated in man-days on a T-shirt scale (XS 0.5, S 1, M 3, L 5, XL 10); parents roll up from the tasks below them.

Unit tests and testing through the Forge tunnel
Time zones and daylight saving edge cases
